title: Resources & Environment: Minerals, Energy, Conservation Recall Quiz

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-metallic mineral?
questions.qPa: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਅਧਾਤਵੀ ਖਣਿਜ (non-metallic mineral) ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Mica is a non-metallic mineral, widely used in the electrical industry.

questions.q: Bauxite is the ore from which which metal is extracted?
questions.qPa: ਬਾਕਸਾਈਟ ਉਹ ਕੱਚੀ ਧਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਤੋਂ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਧਾਤ ਕੱਢੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Aluminum is obtained from bauxite ore.

questions.q: Which state in India is the leading producer of Iron Ore?
questions.qPa: ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੋਹੇ ਦੀ ਕੱਚੀ ਧਾਤ ਦਾ ਮੋਹਰੀ ਉਤਪਾਦਕ ਰਾਜ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Odisha consistently holds the largest reserves and is the leading producer of iron ore in India.

questions.q: Which is the most abundantly available fossil fuel in India?
questions.qPa: ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਮਾਤਰਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਪਥਰਾਟ ਬਾਲਣ (fossil fuel) ਕਿਹੜਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Coal provides the bulk of commercial energy needs in India.

questions.q: Which of the following is a non-conventional source of energy?
questions.qPa: ਹੇਠ ਲਿਖਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਊਰਜਾ ਦਾ ਗੈਰ-ਰਵਾਇਤੀ ਸਰੋਤ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Solar energy is renewable and non-conventional, unlike fossil fuels.

questions.q: Digboi in Assam is famous for:
questions.qPa: ਆਸਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਡਿਗਬੋਈ (Digboi) ਕਿਸ ਲਈ ਮਸ਼ਹੂਰ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Digboi is the oldest operating oil well in India.

questions.qPa: ਟਿਕਾਊ ਵਿਕਾਸ (Sustainable development) ਦਾ ਕੀ ਅਰਥ ਹੈ?
options: Development without damaging the environment and compromising future needs
questions.explanation: It balances current developmental needs with environmental preservation for future generations.

questions.q: Which practice helps in the conservation of minerals?
questions.qPa: ਕਿਹੜਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਖਣਿਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Recycling metals like scrap iron or aluminum reduces the need to mine new ore.
